title: Return a JSON object
summary: ASP.NET Web API: Return a JSON object. Add an author field.
introduction: Ok creates a successful response with data. Open GET /book. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Return a JSON object with ASP.NET Web API

blocks.text: Install the .NET SDK. Run dotnet new web -n SchoolApi and enter it. Replace Program.cs with one example. Run dotnet run --urls http://127.0.0.1:8000. These examples use controllers without a database.

blocks.title: Return a JSON object

blocks.text: Ok wraps the anonymous object in a 200 response, and the web formatter writes JSON.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Return data objects so the framework serialises them.
